item.title: Christmas Celebration
item.content: Beneath the glow of that ancient Bethlehem star lies a story that reveals the very heart of God. In the birth of Jesus, we don’t just see a holy night — we see a holy God drawing close to humanity with humility, faithfulness, and unstoppable love. This Advent season, we’ll uncover the deeper story beneath the manger scenes and Christmas lights — a story that shows us who God truly is and how His heart is still reaching for us today.

item.title: VIP Sunday
item.content:
VIP Sunday – A Day to Honor Someone Special! 
On Sunday Nov. 2 we’re celebrating the people who’ve made a difference in our lives!
This is the perfect Sunday to bring someone who doesn’t usually come to church — and show them what it looks like to be known, welcomed, and loved.

Invite your “Very Important Person” — a friend, neighbor, coworker, or family member — for a morning designed to make them feel loved and valued by you.

We’ll have a red carpet welcome, special gifts for our VIP guests, and a uplifting, relatable message that speaks to real life.

8:30 or 9:30 am
VIP check-in 15 minutes before both services.

Thrive Revive in ’25 — Let’s Build for the Next Generation (and Enjoy More Coffee Together ☕)

Thrive family, we’ve got exciting news to share! Someone in our church has generously given a $10,000 matching grant to help us revitalize two important areas of our church life: our Children’s Ministry area and our Café space.

Here’s why this matters:
• Our Children’s Ministry currently lacks walls, making it noisy and distracting. We want to create a beautiful, fresh, quiet environment where kids can encounter God’s love.
• Our Café has become one of Thrive’s best connection points but is running out of room! We’ll expand seating and update the look to reflect Thrive’s warm, welcoming culture.

Every dollar you give will be doubled up to $10,000 — meaning we can raise $20,000 total!

This isn’t just about paint and walls—it’s about building spaces where kids grow in faith and friendships flourish.

Give via: Zelle address: give@thrivevineyard.com — include “Thrive Revive” in the memo, or give by check.

With gratitude and excitement,
Kevin

post.post_content:
Baptism Sunday - August 31

Baptism is one of the most beautiful ways we get to say “yes” to Jesus!

At Thrive Vineyard, we believe baptism is a public celebration of a personal decision – an outward expression of the inward transformation Jesus has done in our lives. It’s a moment where we invite the Holy Spirit to meet us in a powerful way as we follow Jesus into a new season of life with Him.

Whether you’ve been following Jesus for years or you’re just beginning to explore what faith looks like, we’d love to walk with you through this next step.

Baptism Classes

If you’re interested in being baptized, join us for one of our baptism classes to learn more about what baptism is all about and what to expect:

  • Sunday, August 17 – 9:00 AM 

  • Sunday, August 24 – 9:00 AM

Classes will be held in the Nest, before service for the two Sundays leading up to our baptism service.

Baptism Sunday

Our baptism celebration will take place during the 9:30 AM service on Sunday, August 31.
Bring your family and friends – this is a church‑wide celebration!

Ready to take the next step?

If you’re ready to be baptized or have questions, fill out the form below, email carley@thrivevineyard.com or talk to us at one of the baptism classes. We can’t wait to celebrate what God is doing in your life!

item.title: Rooted: The Story of God
item.content:
Rooted: The Story of God is a small group experience designed to help you see the big picture of Scripture and discover your place in God’s unfolding story. Together, we’ll explore how the Bible fits together, how God has been at work from the beginning, and how His story shapes our everyday lives. Whether you’re new to faith or have been following Jesus for years, this group will help you grow deeper roots in truth, purpose, and community.

Deepen your theological understanding and help Vineyard USA beta-test a NEW piece of the Vineyard USA Ordination process, Seminary Now, with Carley! Seminary Now is an online educational platform offering on-demand video courses. There are many courses to choose from, and work is done individually. Once you have completed your work, the Learning Community will chat over Zoom about the material! Vineyard USA requires each person to complete a survey before and after the coursework. GUESS WHAT?!? When you sign up to join Thrive’s learning group, all coursework is FREE through Vineyard USA! One course is selected each month. You complete the coursework online and we'll meet at the end of the month!  Nov 20th, 7pm: Managing Anxiety: Yours and Theirs  / Self-Regulation / Steve Cuss Dec 23rd, 7pm: Women in the New Testament /  Bible  / Women in Ministry / Lynn Cohick Jan 29th, 7pm:  Uncommon Church Community / Transformation / Alvin Sander
